title: Kaneo plugin catalog
description: Community plugins listed on kaneo.app/plugins. Entries are sorted by package name and each package appears once; scripts/catalog/check.mjs enforces both.

package.description: The npm package name, as passed to kaneo plugin add.

repository.description: The public source repository, as an https URL.

description.description: One line about what the plugin does.

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames of the people responsible for the plugin, without @.

kaneo.description: The Kaneo versions the plugin supports, as a semver range such as >=2.29.0 <3.

addedAt.description: The date the plugin was listed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

homepage.description: Optional documentation or project page, as an https URL.
